shortDescription: Manage and inspect an OpenVPN certificate revocation list.

options.name: expire_in_days
options.description: Threshold in days used to determine whether the CRL is near expiry. If C(next_update - now <= expire_in_days), the module returns C(expired=true).

options.name: force
options.description: Reserved for compatibility with existing playbooks. Currently not used by the module logic.

options.name: list_revoked_certificates
options.description: Include the parsed list of revoked certificates in the module result.

options.name: pki_dir
options.description: Path to the Easy-RSA PKI directory. The module expects the CRL file at C(<pki_dir>/crl.pem).

options.name: state
options.description: Operation mode of the module. Use C(status) to inspect the current CRL. Use C(renew) to regenerate the CRL using Easy-RSA.

options.name: warn_for_expire
options.description: Evaluate whether the CRL is near expiry based on O(expire_in_days). Adds C(expired) to the result. Adds C(warn=true) when the CRL is considered near expiry.

options.name: working_dir
options.description: Working directory used before running Easy-RSA commands. Useful when Easy-RSA must be executed from a specific directory.
